title: Bulwayiye Baba
body:
Khat likhti hain aaye momino iss tarha se sughra bulwaai ye baba, furkhat mein huwa haal bohat gair hain mera bulwaai ye baba, bhaiyya Ali Akbar ke fida ammu ke sadqhe, baba se ye kehke, ab hogayi furqat main lab-e-gor yeh dukhiya bulwaaiye baba, kehna ye Sakina se ke aaye raaj dulaari, aaye baba ki pyaari, dhandar makaan usme akeli hain wo dukhiya bulwaaiye baba , sunti hoon ke shaadi bane Qasim ki racchi hai, mujhko bhi khushi hai, main dekhu na kya bhayi bahen dono ka sehra bulwaaiye baba, din raat tasawoor hain har ek khurdu kala ka , kuch bus nahin mera, majboor hoon bebas hoon tarasti hoon hamesha bulwaaiye baba, jab dekhti hoon shahe nasheen apki khaali, na khushyo mawaali, jis simt nazar karti hoon ghar dikhta hain soona bulwaaiye baba, rahaat kisi dam din ko na araam hain shab ko
Bas kehti hoon roro, hamrah hain sab apke main hogayi tanhaa bulwaaiye baba..
